page.title: Reports
page.description: Generate and download PDFs from appointments, invoices, labels, daily income, journals, loans, and delivery routes.

pickup.title: Pickup manifest
pickup.description: Print the appointment pickup list for a visit or daily route.

delivery.title: Delivery manifest
delivery.description: Print the delivery list for a daily route.

label.title: Labels
label.description: Print barcode labels for an invoice or a barcode number.

income.title: Daily income
income.description: Print the closeout for a branch and date.

journal.title: Journal
journal.description: Print a single daily-income journal by reference.

loan.title: Loans
loan.description: Print employee loan statements for a date range.
